## mourner-d17 — bearer <redacted> to Hannah
> YOU PICK [agency:ask_expedition] 
YOU: "What did you see out there?"
NPC: "Watch for this: It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. Sunback, every time. It hunts by day — watch the open ground."

> YOU PICK [agency:ask_field] 
YOU: "Teach me something from the wild."
NPC: "Nightlight — A soft green glow under the water. It hunts at night — give the dark a wide berth."

> YOU PICK [agency:ask_field] 
YOU: "Teach me something from the wild."
NPC: "This one — Strychnine Tree. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."

> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "I've got theories. Most of them are just fear with better lighting."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "I — yeah. It helps, hearing that. I mean it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "You're kind. Don't let this place change that."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there…"

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Most days I don't think about it. Today I am. Appreciate you noticing."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."

> YOU PICK [dlg:comfort] 
NPC: "I — yeah. It helps, hearing that."
NPC: "That's enough for now. It'll percolate."


### FULL TRANSCRIPT
NPC: "We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
YOU: "What did you see out there?"

NPC: "This one — Strychnine Tree. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "I've got theories. Most of them are just fear with better lighting."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Thanks. ...Thanks for saying that."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "I — yeah. It helps, hearing that. I mean it."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "You're kind. Don't let this place change that."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Heh. Nobody's asked me that in a while. ...I'm alright. Getting there…"
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: They shake their head, then nod — both true at once. "Talk to me a bit. That helps more than anything."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: "Most days I don't think about it. Today I am. Appreciate you noticing."
YOU: "Are you okay?"
NPC: A long exhale. "I'll get there. Just needed a minute where I didn't have to be fine."
